name: Lone work arrangements review
summary: For each task someone does alone, the manager gets the check-in method, the places where nobody could be reached, who responds when a check-in is missed and how soon, and alternatives. A competent person decides what is acceptable.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of health, safety and environment work, and its own method for reviewing lone-work arrangements: tasks, check-in methods, places and responders read against company-set limits.
